haggai.1.p1.b1.text: The word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest

haggai.1.p1.b2.text: In the second year of the reign of Darius, on the first day of the sixth month,

haggai.1.p1.b3.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says:

haggai.1.p1.b4.text: “These people say, ‘The time has not yet come to rebuild the house of the LORD.’”

haggai.1.p1.b5.text: “Is it a time for you yourselves to live in your paneled houses, while this house lies in ruins?”

haggai.1.p1.b6.text: Now this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Consider carefully your ways.

haggai.1.p1.b7.text: You have planted much but harvested little. You eat but never have enough. You drink but never have your fill. You put on clothes but never get warm.

haggai.1.p1.b8.text: You earn wages to put into a bag pierced through.

haggai.1.p2.b1.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Consider carefully your ways.

haggai.1.p2.b2.text: Go up into the hills, bring down lumber, and build the house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be glorified, says the LORD.

haggai.1.p2.b3.text: Why? … Because My house still lies in ruins, while each of you is busy with his own house.

haggai.1.p2.b4.text: You expected much, but behold, it amounted to little. And what you brought home, I blew away.

haggai.1.p2.b5.text: Therefore, on account of you the heavens have withheld their dew and the earth has withheld its crops.

haggai.1.p2.b6.text: I have summoned a drought on the fields and on the mountains, on the grain, new wine, and oil, and on whatever the ground yields, on man and beast, and on all the labor of your hands.”

haggai.1.p3.b1.text: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, as well as all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God … So the people feared the LORD.

haggai.1.p3.b2.text: Haggai, the messenger of the LORD, delivered the message of the LORD to the people:

haggai.1.p3.b3.text: “I am with you,” declares the LORD.

haggai.1.p3.b4.text: So the LORD stirred the spirit of Zerubbabel … and the spirit of Joshua … the high priest, as well as the spirit of all the remnant of the people. And they came and began the work on the house of the LORD of Hosts, their God

haggai.1.p3.b5.text: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Darius.
